newsitem.title: INDIA: India's HZL zinc and lead prices for January 1997.
newsitem.headline: India's HZL zinc and lead prices for January 1997.

text.p: Following are zinc and lead prices for January 1997 announced by the state-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd and circulated by the Bombay Metals Exchange Ltd.

HZL brand zinc and lead prices, effective January 1, 1997 and valid till further notice, ex-godowns at Sewree, Thane, Kalamboli, Nagpur, Nanded, Pune, Margao, Goa, Daman, Silvassa and ex-smelters given below:

Over and above the basic prices declared above, excise duty of 15 percent (or actuals), octroi (entry tax) service charges, octroi duty and sales tax will be charged extra. In the case of sale within Goa state, local sales-tax of 2.0 percent will be charged extra, then CST of 2.0 percent will be levied against Form "C". C-Forms are to be submitted on a bill-wise basis.
S.H.G.Zinc : On upliftment of 20 MT & above - Rs 300/-per MT
PW /Z-98 : On upliftment of 30 to 100 MT - Rs 500/-Per MT
: On upliftment of 101 to 200 MT -Rs 750/-Per MT
: On Upliftment of 201 MT & above -Rs 1000/-Per MT
LEAD :(a) 60 days interest-free credit against confirmed LC
(b)Against 100% advance payment, a cash discount of Rs 1,500/- per MT will be given
On upliftment of 20 MT to 49 MT - Rs 500/- Per MT
On upliftment of 50 MT & above - Rs 750/- Per MT
